question: How does consciousness-nature cognition function as both action and yoga?
premises: That consciousness-nature cognition rests upon the outer group of principles that initiate the body.
That same cognition is yoga when it brings the principles to dissolution in consciousness.
inference: The one consciousness-nature cognition operates through the body-initiating principles as action and culminates as yoga by dissolving those principles into consciousness.
uncertainties: The long compound dehārambhibāhyasthatattvabrātādhiśāyinī admits more than one internal grouping.
plain_english: That same cognition, which rests upon the outer range of principles that give rise to the body, is action. And that very same cognition becomes yoga when it dissolves those principles back into consciousness.
